doc.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Thanks exchanged, a remark on Joe Williams's youthful looks, and Rowe's sign-off for Hamilton College.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thanks for meeting with Joe this morning.
My pleasure. It was my pleasure to do that interview. He’s so good.
Do you believe that he’s over 50 years old? He doesn’t look it. Does he?
No. He’s great. So on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank Leslie Gourse, and hope to be reading your next publication soon.
Well I hope so. Thanks a lot.
